faq.q: Are there any active Dig & Clean codes right now?
faq.a: Yes. As of August 13, 2026, UPDATE1 (2x Luck for 30 minutes) and SECRET10 (10x Luck for 10 minutes) are active. You must complete the tutorial before the code box appears in the Shop.

faq.q: When will Dig & Clean codes be released?
faq.a: Roblox simulation games usually add codes after major updates or milestones. The first codes arrived with Update 1 around August 9, 2026. We monitor the official channels and update this page as soon as new codes appear.

faq.q: How do I redeem a code in Dig & Clean?
faq.a: Open the game, click the Shop button on the left side of the screen, scroll to the bottom, paste the code exactly, and click Redeem. The redemption box only appears after you finish the tutorial.

faq.q: Do codes give free shovels or coins?
faq.a: The current codes give timed Luck boosts. When future codes arrive, rewards will likely be coins or small boosts — we will list the exact reward for every confirmed code.

faq.q: Can I use codes from DIG or Dig It in Dig & Clean?
faq.a: No. DIG and Dig It are different games. Only codes published specifically for Dig & Clean by Squeaky Clean! will work.
